detail.longDescription: 🤖 NEW: A # Caltech -built # robot under a # DARPA program assembled part of a structural truss in # orbit on its own, connecting tubes and joints into repeating bays. The # experiment aimed to build a 1.4-meter reflector antenna but was not completed. The test suggests rockets no longer have to dictate the size of large # telescopes , antennas, and # solar arrays. 👉 https://www. sciencedaily.com/releases/2026 /11/261108233043.htm # space # robotics # engineering # satellite # nasa # technology # tech # science # astronomy # manufacturing # education # research
